answer: Each agent pair posts a refundable deposit that only clears after a long, random performance audit, so a Sybil cluster costs real capital per identity. Forging a thousand puppets means buying a thousand deposits and surviving a thousand independent reviews, like a costly voyage on which every hull must pass the same customs. Track each opal of value by its proven human or bonded origin, so fresh puppets inherit no history, and refuse to route settlement to an unpublished knoll of unreviewed addresses.
